cells.name: Registered application snapshot
cells.requiredEvidence: Real initialized file-backed PartitionService through production wrapper and manually invoked registered callback; before v2 capture, source cluster identity is read through authoritative CONFIG owner-RPC with no cache/default fallback. Prove schema, indexes, acknowledged rows, committed transaction/statement outcomes, HLC and sqlite sequence state through the boundary; exclude source HardState/vote/lifecycle/runtime tables; refuse LOCAL_STAGING or unresolved PREPARED state before publication without claiming durable PREPARE. Genuine source publication is NOT_REACHED until the owner-red transition is fixed.

cells.name: Independent publication and group generation
cells.requiredEvidence: Exact v2 D/M/N shape: singleton raft_rs_checkpoint_manifest(manifest_json), canonical M with payloadVersion2 and no membershipEpoch, D carrying membershipEpoch as the routing/publication freshness fact, and N={bindingVersion:1, checkpoint:C} with membershipEpoch omitted. Positive publication9/durable generation0 succeeds when each matches its owner. Canonical wrong generation mutates only D.raftRs.membershipGenerationIndex while payload bytes/M/N remain unchanged: validateCheckpointDescriptor remains VALID and readCheckpoint returns CORRUPT_PAYLOAD with RAFT_RS_CHECKPOINT_REASON.MANIFEST_GENERATION_MISMATCH. Stale publication, foreign group and malformed decimal controls remain separate.

cells.name: Intact member election-safe catch-up and native install admission
cells.requiredEvidence: Open exact intact lagging member through LOCAL_OPEN, preserve target local identity/incarnation/election state, exercise delayed/old-leader, loss-of-quorum, joint/history and configuration-change schedules against the actual receiver owner, and require an actual receiver-native accepted Snapshot in Ready with exact v2 image/native binding before install. Final R3 must not use direct requestSnapshotInstall without receiver native Ready as authority. The old CREATE/learner requestSnapshotInstall refusal remains historical component evidence only, not the final intact-member R3 red or receipt. Source record identity remains source lifecycle identity, never target identity.

cells.name: Local open safety, known wipe, read unavailability and cold restart
cells.requiredEvidence: Exercise the supported-fault LOCAL_OPEN/KNOWN_WIPE/READ_UNAVAILABLE matrix from the R4 future witness: absent/noncanonical HardState term or vote; missing log; contradictory snapshot; applied beyond log; empty or contradictory ConfState; negative generation; missing applied row with other raft facts present; lifecycle missing/unreadable/retired/wrong incarnation; identity/reservation and durable group mismatch. Each negative proves typed pre-core refusal or owner failure with no unsafe install/campaign/vote/participation; positives keep legal vote0 and coherent lag. Pair with same-byte KNOWN_WIPE HOLD replay and three intact voters cold restarting, electing and committing without a preexisting leader. Historical old-DB clone rollback diagnostics are excluded.

cells.name: Exact fresh learner CREATE component
cells.requiredEvidence: Exact learner reservation, operation/admission/attempt/physical-worker identity, retry, terminal-first/admission-first, release/reclaim rotation, wrong role/worker/identity and successor generation. Include REPLACE source_replica_id retention, genuine owner-produced branded A/B evidence and physical-worker claim cross-wire at requestSnapshotInstall, old boot evidence refusal, explicit late A CREATE/admission fence after A closure and B admission, exact-generation cleanup preserving B bytes/artifacts, and operation settlement versus cleanup/deletion separation. Component proof remains supplemental and does not unpark FreshMG or prove v2 application-complete compatibility.

cells.name: Refusal and continuation preserve service
cells.requiredEvidence: Use concrete receiver-native pending/refusal schedules. Bulk VALID/STAGED without a matching native snapshot returns AWAITING_NATIVE_SNAPSHOT, preserves the live service and cannot be labelled native rejection. A real packet that native does not admit yields native_snapshot_not_admitted for image install only; binding mismatch yields native_snapshot_binding_mismatch before step/import. Refusal causes no application-image import/swap, destructive service shutdown, local lifecycle change or accepted-install marker. Previously verified unaccepted staging may remain under its exact finite lease or be released by its transfer owner; expiry/cleanup affects only that exact stage/pin and cannot delete successor artifacts. Lawful receiver-native term/entry writes remain allowed. Accepted Ready uses the atomic same-main-DB app barrier and exact completion binding; no separate debt or re-registration claim is made.

cells.name: Real intact owner interaction
cells.requiredEvidence: Manual trigger initiates production-registered source path, authoritative source identity, private durable-first native publication, real emitted MsgSnapshot N, bulk stage, unchanged packet handoff, private report_snapshot feedback through SERVICE_RESPONSE/local handler completion, receiver Ready with exactly N, physical combined Ready/app/import commit, same-service continuation or successor fence, restart and later entry replay. Include below-boundary request, too-new request temporary-unavailable/new publication, dropped-packet Failure then native re-emission, stale feedback rejection, empty-tail boundary, B<K joint restart, durable-before-native failure cuts and continuous writes without needless recapture. Callback plus bulk OFFER alone is insufficient. A concrete future-green R7 suite must exist before seal; an absent suite, R1 reused callback red or BLOCKED placeholder cannot satisfy preseal. R7 exercises manual registered dispatch and intact local restart only; FreshMG workflow, two-replace/off-seed placement, automatic lag triggering and wiped-voter replacement remain parked.
